newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends unchanged in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends unchanged in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended unchanged on Friday from New York's Thursday close, with trade marked only by light Japanese sales in pre-opening business, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$369.00/50 an ounce.
"The market was quiet but interesting," said one senior dealer.
He noted that no selling pressure had emerged despite gold trading near the top end of the range.
"The range has been seen at between $368 and $370, and for the past few days we've been trading near the top end and haven't seen any selling pressure," the senior dealer said.
This meant market expectations of sales appeared unfounded, he added.
Other traders reported some physical sales.
Local gold ended unchanged at HK$3,408 a tael.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to -2.00 from its previous fix at -4.00.
